review.method: Manual gross-feature identification in eight orthogonal/oblique source-mesh views, surface ray projection and annotated multi-view review. No automatic anatomical inference.
review.limitation: Polygon-reduced gross bony surface; not cartilage, histology or a segmented feature mask.

transverse-left.reviewNote: Lateral end of left transverse process

transverse-right.reviewNote: Lateral end of right transverse process

features.name: Vertebral body
features.description: Anterior load-bearing region.
features.relations: The arch lies behind it; adjacent bodies are connected through discs.
features.reason: Gross feature reviewed against source-mesh views; independent anatomical review pending.

features.name: Superior bony endplate
features.description: Upper bony surface of the vertebral body.
features.relations: Faces the disc above. The model does not resolve the cartilaginous endplate.
features.reason: Gross feature reviewed against source-mesh views; independent anatomical review pending.

features.name: Inferior bony endplate
features.description: Lower bony surface of the vertebral body.
features.relations: Faces the disc below; this marker identifies bone, not cartilage.
features.reason: Gross feature reviewed against source-mesh views; independent anatomical review pending.

features.name: Spinous process
features.description: Midline projection extending backward and downward.
features.relations: Muscle and ligament attachment region; the marker is not an attachment footprint.
features.reason: Gross feature reviewed against source-mesh views; independent anatomical review pending.

features.name: Left transverse process
features.description: Left lateral projection of the vertebral arch.
features.relations: Its anterior extremity carries the transverse costal facet.

anchor.reviewNote: Lateral end of left transverse process

features.reason: Gross feature reviewed against source-mesh views; independent anatomical review pending.

features.name: Right transverse process
features.description: Right lateral projection of the vertebral arch.
features.relations: Its anterior extremity carries the transverse costal facet.

anchor.reviewNote: Lateral end of right transverse process

features.name: Vertebral foramen
features.description: Opening bounded by body and arch.
features.relations: A space, not a bony surface point; no marker is placed in empty space.
features.reason: An anatomical space has no single surface attachment.
